ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark gray) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white clusters are concentrated at the distal tips; dense high-intensity punctate spots are distributed across the right lobe; diffused mid-intensity gray mottling is visible on the proximal and medial left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude (5-12 pixels) irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary, exhibiting a sharp saw-tooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge from the distal tips to the notch; convex curve visible on the leading edges towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of circular high-contrast pixel formations at both distal tips; sparse to moderate distribution of individual white circular spots across the medial ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization manifesting as heavily textured, high-contrast clusters on the distal tips and outer margins of both lobes; widespread white scarring marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in punctate marking density, with the right lobe showing significantly higher frequency of high-intensity spots than the left lobe.
